core_claims: the 1m composite DTM covers about 99 percent of England
DTM production uses the last or only laser return
surface objects are removed using algorithms and manual editing
the referenced composite was produced in 2022
the composite combines Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys
repeat coverage uses the newest best-resolution survey
resampled data uses bilinear interpolation
the 2022 composite source period runs from 6 June 2000 to 2 April 2022
metadata index catalogues identify the survey used at a location
composite raster downloads are GeoTIFF
composite data is supplied in 5km tiles
tiles align to the OS National Grid
elevation values are in metres
heights are referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn
the composite uses the OSTN15 transformation method
input surveys have stated vertical accuracy of plus or minus 15cm RMSE
the dataset CRS is EPSG:27700
the listed update frequency is annual
the dataset is available under the Open Government Licence
a WMS service is listed
a WCS service is listed
a WMTS service is listed
an OGC API Features service is listed
Time Stamped DTM resolutions include 25cm 50cm 1m and 2m while point clouds use LAZ
